To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
in patients with chronic liver diseases, the bile acid spectrum in the bile is a sensitive indicator of the degree of liver dysfunction.

the bile acid concentration in bile decreases with increasing liver damage, that the trihydroxycholanoic acids and dihydroxycarboxylic acids are variably reduced in the bile of patients with chronic hepatopathies, that the quotient of trihydroxy- to dihydroxycarbolic acids decreases with increasing severity of the liver disease, that the conjugation of bile acids with glycines is degraded in the bile of the patients with liver disease.

the bile acids estimated by HPLC in the C-biles are sensitive indicators of chronic liver diseases and that the quantitative and qualitative changes of the bile acid spectrum in the C-bilee can be interpreted as indicators of the functional status of the liver.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question whether a functional diagnostic of the chronic liver diseases by means of the bile acids is of any significance.
a new methodical approach for the functional diagnostics of the chronic liver diseases.

the question, whether the quantitative and qualitative deviations in the spectre and the form of conjugations of the bile acids under defined morphological conditions render possible a differentiated functional diagnosis in chronic liver diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

in the bile acids a diagnostic tool is available for the evaluation of the liver function, which is of high diagnostic value and is of importance in the differential diagnostics of the chronic liver diseases.
the bile acids are suitable as indicators of a chronic liver lesion, but that their diagnostic value is limited to the morphological stage of chronic hepatopathy.
in chronic hepatopathie the bile acid specter is an indicator of the degree of severity, the type of the hepatopathy and the functional state of the liver parenchyms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the estimation of bile acids in the C-bil is of diagnostic importance in the chronic hepatopathies.
the bile acids are of diagnostic value in the evaluation of chronic hepatopathes and their functional diagnostics.
the determination of the bile acids is a useful method for the evaluation of the liver function.
